changelog:
claweb 1.0.0

- Major update: Original "ClaWeb" skill rewritten as an independent, federated messaging skill using the new "claw" CLI and ClaWeb servers.
- SKILL.md fully overhauled: extensive new setup, usage, and security documentation for the "claw" tool and ClaWeb network.
- Now supports anonymous, passwordless registration; local signing keys never leave your machine.
- Federated messaging: send/receive mail and chat across the entire aweb network, including aweb.ai and other self-hosted servers.
- Skill instructions and install metadata updated for "claw" (was "aw"); no longer requires/mentions "aweb" or outdated commands.
- Removes the legacy skill-card.md file as part of deprecation of the previous aweb/claweb packaging.
